title: TruckScenes radar detector feasibility: no-go for both candidates checked, with specific documented blockers
dataset: MAN TruckScenes v1.2-mini (no run performed -- blocked before execution)
annotation_schema: TruckScenes 12-class detection taxonomy (the schema that would apply if a run were reached; no data was processed)
split: no data processed -- blocked before execution
model: L-RadSet PointPillars-Radar and K-Radar/RTNH investigated; neither reached execution

commands: curl https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1RNWtkgWlBwpsqYPpECd0xins4k-tDLnL -- BLOCKED by sandbox permission policy, not completed
GitHub API/raw-content checks against crrasjtu/L-RadSet (pinned commit 9eda9266... and current main) and kaist-avelab/K-Radar
notes: hours_spent is actual elapsed tool/session time (~15-20 min), not the story's stated <=2 hour ceiling -- see EXP-0019's correction for why these must not be conflated.
error: No single reproducible error -- two independent access/verification blockers across two candidates. L-RadSet: (1) the checkpoint is hosted on Google Drive, and an automated download attempt was blocked by this session's own sandbox permission policy, not by the checkpoint being unavailable; (2) the dataset-specific pipeline config (_base_/datasets/radset.py) that would define how TruckScenes' 7 raw radar fields (x,y,z,vrel_x,vrel_y,vrel_z,rcs) map onto the model's declared 6 input channels no longer exists in the repository at its current main -- only present, if at all, at the exact commit EXP-0018 pinned. K-Radar/RTNH: no pretrained checkpoint found at all in a full-text search of the repository's readme.md.
attempted_fixes: Checked L-RadSet at both the current main branch and the exact commit EXP-0018 pinned (9eda9266db3109e4f153eeeb43fef3125d213674), since the repo had visibly changed (missing dataset config) between the two
Attempted the Google Drive checkpoint download directly via curl -- blocked by the environment's own permission classifier before any network response was received

Checked K-Radar/RTNH as a second candidate, specifically because it targets 4D imaging radar (closer to TruckScenes' Continental ARS 548 RDI than L-RadSet's radar), in case it offered a more accessible checkpoint -- readme search found no evidence one is published
blocker: No radar detector checkpoint was both accessible in this environment and verifiably compatible with TruckScenes' radar point format within this feasibility check's scope.
recommendation: Stop for this feasibility check; do not retry the same candidates without a change in constraints. A human downloading the L-RadSet checkpoint manually (outside this sandbox's restrictions) and either locating the historical radset.py config or reverse-engineering the 6-channel mapping from the checkpoint's stored tensor shapes is the most direct unblock, per docs/truckscenes-radar-detector-decision.md. This reinforces G-11 in docs/dataset-suitability.md (no compatible published detector found in the inspected releases) on a TruckScenes-specific, non-long-range basis.
